documentation: PlantPAX-style Analog Input (P_AIn) for the PlantPAX Perspective faceplates. Simulated 4-20 mA input; replace Val/Inp_PV with an OPC tag (or point instances at the PLC AOI) for real I/O.
name: P_AIn

eventScripts.script:
if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Sts/Sts_SubstPV'], [False])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
	v = system.tag.readBlocking([base + '/Val/Val'])[0].value
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Cmd/MSet_SubstPV', base + '/Sts/Sts_SubstPV'], [v, True])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
	v = system.tag.readBlocking([base + '/Val/Val'])[0].value
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Val/Val_PVMaxCapt', base + '/Val/Val_PVMinCapt'], [v, v])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 2)[0]
	names = ['HiHi', 'Hi', 'Lo', 'LoLo', 'Fail']
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/' + n + '/Ack' for n in names], [True] * len(names))
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Disabled'], [True])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Disabled'], [False])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Ack'], [True])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Shelved'], [True])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

if initialChange or not currentValue.value:
		return
	tp = str(tagPath)
	base = tp.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
	system.tag.writeBlocking([base + '/Shelved'], [False])
	system.tag.writeBlocking([tp], [False])

tags.expression: if({[.]Disabled} || {[.]Shelved} || {[.]Suppressed} || !{[.]Cfg_Exists}, 0, if({[.]Alm} || !{[.]Ack}, toInt(max(1, min(4, ceil({[.]../Cfg/Cfg_FailSeverity} / 250.0)))) * 2 + if({[.]Ack}, 0, 1), 0))
tags.name: Val_Notify
